app_id.description: The public app ID (e.g. 5X3c4veRGV) from list_apps

app_version.description: Filter by app version ID (integer). Get version IDs from list_app_versions.

cursor.description: Pagination cursor from pagination.next in a previous response.

date_range_end.description: ISO 8601 datetime string (e.g. 2026-04-28T23:59:59Z). Date-only strings like 2026-04-28 are also accepted.

date_range_start.description: ISO 8601 datetime string (e.g. 2026-04-28T00:00:00Z). Date-only strings like 2026-04-28 are also accepted.

device_udid.description: Filter to a specific device by its UDID from search_devices.

page_size.description: Number of results per page. Defaults to 100, max 200. Use smaller values (e.g. 25) to avoid truncation.

tags.description: Filter by log tags (e.g. ["ERROR", "NETWORK"]). Tags are user-defined string labels.
